title.en: Caesar / Miyabi / Yanagi: Fallen Frost cycle

summary.zh: 先套盾与减益，再以烈霜和柳的紊乱回点；6落霜时交雅兑现。
summary.en: Prepare shield/debuff, then use Frost and Yanagi’s Disorder to restore resource for Miyabi’s six-point slash.

conditions.zh: 本方案普通切人不依赖固定槽位；三人都保留各自真实技能条件。
conditions.en: This route uses ordinary switches without a fixed slot requirement; all real skill conditions still apply.

conditions.zh: 凯撒加攻属于当前护盾持有人；本轴让雅关键斩击前台结算，不承诺提前切出无损。
conditions.en: Caesar’s ATK belongs to the current shield holder. Miyabi resolves key slashes on field; early switching is not claimed lossless.

conditions.zh: 参考1.4作者组合思路，机制按固定3.3资料复核；一次柳EX不保证双紊乱，也不保证立即回满6落霜。
conditions.en: The 1.4 team concept is checked against fixed 3.3 mechanics. One Yanagi EX does not guarantee double Disorder or six Fallen Frost.

label.zh: 小橙子 · 雅柳异常队（1.4）

objective.zh: 先盾和减益，再建立异常回点循环。
objective.en: Prepare shield and debuff, then establish Anomaly resource cycling.

input.zh: 能量足够时点按强化特殊技。
input.en: Press EX Special with sufficient energy.

trigger.zh: 护盾缺失或需要刷新；1影开局已有盾时检查后可跳过。
trigger.en: The shield is absent or needs refreshing. Check and skip if M1 already supplied it at battle start.

complete.zh: 确认荣光之盾实际存在后再安排输出。
complete.en: Verify Radiant Aegis actually exists before the damage sequence.

reason.zh: 该盾由当前操作角色持有，加攻跟随持有者；雅切至后台时不假定仍吃持盾加攻。
reason.en: The currently controlled agent holds the shield and its ATK bonus. Miyabi is not assumed to retain that holder bonus off field.

fallback.zh: 无能量可等待合法招架／反击机会，不能用未触发条件的普通特殊技当作已套盾。
fallback.en: Without energy, wait for a valid parry/counter opportunity; an unqualified normal Special is not shield application.

input.zh: 有支援点时长按普攻：此路不通！
input.en: With Assist Points, hold Basic: Dead End.

trigger.zh: 该减益尚未通过精准格挡、招架等方式获得，且有至少1支援点。
trigger.en: The debuff was not already applied through a Perfect Block or Assist, and at least one Assist Point is available.

complete.zh: 完成招式，并确认目标在凯撒附近的有效范围。
complete.en: Complete the move with the target within Caesar’s effective nearby area.

reason.zh: 护盾与额外能力减益是两项条件，不能只按一次EX就自动认为全套齐全。
reason.en: The shield and Additional Ability debuff have separate triggers; one EX is not automatically the whole setup.

fallback.zh: 没有支援点或状态已在就跳过；等待真实精准格挡／招架机会补条件。
fallback.en: Skip without Assist Points or if the effect is already active; use an actual Perfect Block or Assist opportunity instead.

signal.en: Switch normally to Miyabi after setup.

title.zh: 雅建立烈霜状态并检查落霜
title.en: Miyabi: establish Frost and check Fallen Frost

input.zh: 用当前可用普攻积蓄；能量足够时用飞雪。
input.en: Build with available Basics; use Hisetsu when energy permits.

trigger.zh: 目标可命中，飞雪分支必须有真实能量。
trigger.en: The target is hittable; the Hisetsu branch requires actual energy.

complete.zh: 确认烈霜异常／霜灼是否真实产生；已有6落霜先三蓄，否则再让柳帮助回点。
complete.en: Check that Frost Anomaly / Frostburn actually occurred. Spend an existing six Fallen Frost first; otherwise use Yanagi to help refill.

reason.zh: 一发EX不保证爆条；本队利用另一属性异常和紊乱帮助雅回点。
reason.en: One EX does not guarantee Anomaly. This team uses another Attribute and Disorder to restore Miyabi’s resource.

fallback.zh: 不足能量就继续可用攻击；若已有6落霜，优先考虑先兑现，避免继续回点溢出。
fallback.en: Without energy, continue available attacks. At six Fallen Frost, consider spending them before further gains overflow.

title.en: Six Fallen Frost: complete the three-level slash on field

input.zh: 实际6落霜时长按普攻，完成三段蓄力。
input.en: Hold Basic with an actual six Fallen Frost, completing all three charge levels.

trigger.zh: 落霜达到6点，护盾与需要的增益有效，目标可命中。
trigger.en: Six Fallen Frost, relevant shield/buffs active, and a hittable target.

complete.zh: 斩击关键命中完成后再切人，不把凯撒持盾加攻视为后台通用增益。
complete.en: Complete the key slash hits before switching; Caesar’s shield-holder ATK is not a universal off-field buff.

reason.zh: 该队选择保留雅前台结算。其他队的三蓄脱手教学不能自动当成雅柳凯的无损方案。
reason.en: This route keeps Miyabi on field for resolution. Early-switch teaching from another team is not automatically lossless here.

fallback.zh: 未满6点先补实际资源；目标离开或受击打断后，重新检查落霜与异常。
fallback.en: Below six, build actual resources. Recheck resource and Anomaly after target movement or interruption.

title.zh: 柳对现有异常打极性紊乱
title.en: Yanagi: apply Polarity Disorder to an existing Anomaly

input.zh: 目标已有属性异常且能量足够时，长按强化特殊技。
input.en: Hold EX Special with enough energy against a target already suffering Anomaly.

trigger.zh: 下落攻击命中时目标仍处于属性异常；不要仅凭积蓄条接近满格就发动。
trigger.en: The target must still be Anomalous when the downward hit lands; nearly full buildup alone is insufficient.

complete.zh: 极性紊乱真实触发后检查雅落霜；只有又实际结算常规紊乱时才同时计两次回复。
complete.en: Check Miyabi’s resource after Polarity Disorder actually triggers. Count both gains only if ordinary Disorder also really occurs.

reason.zh: 极性紊乱不会清除已有异常，也不保证一次EX自动打出感电和常规紊乱。
reason.en: Polarity Disorder does not remove the existing Anomaly, and one EX does not guarantee Shock plus ordinary Disorder.

fallback.zh: 异常已消失则先重新建立；能量不足时用普攻及合法流转积蓄，不假装极性紊乱已经发生。
fallback.en: Re-establish Anomaly if it expired. Without energy, build with Basics and legal stance changes; do not assume Polarity Disorder occurred.

signal.zh: 检查实际落霜后切回雅；不足6点先继续资源准备。
signal.en: Return to Miyabi after checking Fallen Frost; below six, continue resource setup.

objective.zh: 观察实际异常与落霜，轮换资源和三蓄输出。
objective.en: Cycle resources and charged damage around actual Anomaly and Fallen Frost.

prep.zh: 凯撒盾或减益缺失先补；已有6落霜可直接从三蓄开始，避免先执行回点步骤。
prep.en: Refresh Caesar’s missing shield/debuff. At six Fallen Frost, start with the charged slash rather than further resource generation.

title.en: Miyabi: establish Frost and check Fallen Frost

title.zh: 柳按第三至五段衔接流转
title.en: Yanagi: use stance changes after hits 3–5

input.zh: 普攻第三、四或五段后点按特殊技，再接当前架势第三段。
input.en: After Basic hit 3, 4 or 5, tap Special and follow with the current stance’s third hit.

trigger.zh: 雅还未到6落霜，且确实到达可快速流转的普攻段数；雅已满点则跳过。
trigger.en: Miyabi is below six Fallen Frost and Yanagi reached a valid Basic segment for the fast stance change. Skip if Miyabi is already full.

complete.zh: 保持当前架势与异常积蓄，实际触发感电／紊乱后检查雅落霜。
complete.en: Maintain stance and buildup; check Miyabi’s resource after actual Shock / Disorder.

reason.zh: 快速流转可接第三段，减少回到物理前两段；不会凭一次循环自动填满异常。
reason.en: The fast change reconnects to hit 3, avoiding the initial Physical hits; one cycle is not assumed to fill buildup.

fallback.zh: 错过衔接则按实际招式恢复；雅已有6点时及时交回，避免继续产点溢出。
fallback.en: Recover from the actual move after a missed link. Hand back once Miyabi has six to avoid resource overflow.

signal.zh: 落霜足够或需要雅刷新烈霜时普通切回。
signal.en: Switch normally when Miyabi has enough resource or must refresh Frost.

objective.zh: 先兑现已有6点，再按终结技和能量补下一次。
objective.en: Spend an existing six, then prepare the next slash through ready Ultimate and energy.

prep.zh: 护盾、减益和资源在窗口前备好；没有实际窗口也可继续常态循环，不空等失衡。
prep.en: Prepare shield, debuff and resources before the window. Continue the regular loop if no real window exists; do not wait idle for Stun.

title.zh: 终结技就绪时再接名残雪
title.en: Follow with a ready Lingering Snow

input.zh: 终结技已经就绪时点按终结技。

trigger.zh: 目标仍可命中，当前窗口允许；已有6落霜时先考虑兑现，避免回点溢出。
trigger.en: Target hittable and window available; at six Fallen Frost, consider spending first to avoid overflow.

complete.zh: 实际发动获得3点落霜；关键命中结束后再继续安排。
complete.en: Actual activation grants three Fallen Frost; complete key hits before continuing.

reason.zh: 终结技既输出也回点，但不能凭它保证下一步必定够6。
reason.en: The Ultimate deals damage and restores resource, but does not guarantee six for the next step.

fallback.zh: 未就绪就跳过，按实际落霜使用飞雪或回柳积蓄。
fallback.en: Skip if unavailable; use Hisetsu or Yanagi’s buildup according to actual Fallen Frost.

title.zh: 按缺口补飞雪，不盲目双E
title.en: Fill the gap with Hisetsu; do not force two EXs

input.zh: 实际能量足够时点按强化特殊技；追加一段需要额外能量。
input.en: Press EX with sufficient energy; its follow-up requires additional energy.

trigger.zh: 落霜尚未达到6，且选择此分支确有能量。
trigger.en: Fallen Frost is below six and sufficient energy is available.

complete.zh: 每段发动后看实际落霜；到6即可转三蓄，不保证一段总能补满。
complete.en: Check Fallen Frost after each activation. At six, charge; one activation is not always enough.

reason.zh: 回复按实际缺口安排。已有6点先兑现；无能量则让柳继续满足异常条件。
reason.en: Fit recovery to the actual gap. Spend six first; without energy, return to Yanagi’s Anomaly setup.

fallback.zh: 不够资源时退出爆发分支，回常态；不要把缺口自动补齐。
fallback.en: If resources remain insufficient, return to the regular loop rather than auto-filling them.

text.zh: 雅1影三蓄命中可主动消除霜灼；先看当前异常，不必机械等待原本的结束。
text.en: Miyabi M1 can remove Frostburn with the three-level slash; read the current Anomaly instead of mechanically waiting for expiry.

text.zh: 雅2影开局6落霜可直接准备三蓄；第5段最后一击可补1点，只在确实命中时计入。
text.en: Miyabi M2 starts with six Fallen Frost; the last hit of Basic 5 can fill one point only when it actually lands.

text.zh: 柳2影可额外耗能重复突刺；结束长按后下落攻击命中异常目标才结算极性紊乱，不能每次突刺都算一次。
text.en: Yanagi M2 can spend extra energy on repeated thrusts. Polarity Disorder resolves on the downward hit against an Anomalous target, not on every thrust.

text.zh: 凯撒1影接战入场可先给盾，但有冷却；不把这份开场盾每轮重新发放。
text.en: Caesar M1 can provide a shield on combat entry, subject to cooldown; it is not re-granted each cycle.

text.zh: 雅专武的冰伤层数由EX发动或队伍中任意角色施加异常触发，逐层检查实际覆盖。
text.en: Miyabi’s signature Ice-DMG stacks require EX use or any squad member applying Anomaly; check actual stack coverage.

text.zh: 柳专武需特殊技命中异常目标才获得相应精通，额外紊乱增益还要达到其精通门槛。
text.en: Yanagi’s signature needs Special hits on an Anomalous target for its Proficiency bonus; its extra Disorder benefit also has a Proficiency threshold.

text.zh: 凯撒专武全队增益需真实破招或极限闪避触发，不能按已装备自动视为生效。
text.en: Caesar’s signature team buff needs an actual Interrupt or Perfect Dodge; equipping it does not activate it automatically.

ROTATION_LESSON_TITLES.雅建立烈霜状态并检查落霜: 普攻积蓄，能量够再点强化特殊技
ROTATION_LESSON_TITLES.柳对现有异常打极性紊乱: 目标已有异常时长按强化特殊技
ROTATION_LESSON_TITLES.柳按第三至五段衔接流转: 普攻后三段接特殊技切换架势
ROTATION_LESSON_TITLES.按缺口补飞雪，不盲目双E: 还缺落霜时再点强化特殊技

ROTATION_LESSON_INPUTS.有支援点时长按普攻：此路不通！: 有支援点时，长按普攻打出重击。
ROTATION_LESSON_INPUTS.用当前可用普攻积蓄；能量足够时用飞雪。: 先用普攻积蓄；能量足够时，点按强化特殊技。
ROTATION_LESSON_INPUTS.普攻第三、四或五段后点按特殊技，再接当前架势第三段。: 普攻第3、4或5段后点按特殊技；再点普攻，接新架势的第三段。
ROTATION_LESSON_INPUTS.实际能量足够时点按强化特殊技；追加一段需要额外能量。: 需要补落霜且能量够时，点按一次强化特殊技；还有能量、仍需补充时才追加一段。

ROTATION_RECOVERY_INPUTS.1091: 用普攻积蓄烈霜；能量够时点按强化特殊技。满6点落霜才长按普攻蓄满三段。
ROTATION_RECOVERY_INPUTS.1221: 点普攻打到第3、4或5段，再点特殊技切换架势；目标已有异常且能量够，才能长按强化特殊技打极性紊乱。

107100002: 本步要长按普攻打重击，没有先点普攻到某一段的要求。
Hold Basic for the heavy strike. No preceding Basic hit number is required.
109100001: 为了积烈霜，点普攻打到第三至第五段；这是本步积蓄路线，不是发动强化特殊技的门槛。
Build Frost Anomaly with Basic hits 3–5; this is a buildup route, not an EX prerequisite.
109100002: 6落霜时长按普攻到第三阶段再释放；这是蓄力等级，不是点三下普攻。
At six Fallen Frost, hold Basic to charge level 3 and release; it is not three taps.
122100002: 切架势的这条普通特殊技路线：在普攻第三、四或五段后点特殊技；切完再点普攻直达新架势第三段。不是强化特殊技的必备前置。
For this normal Special stance change, tap Special after Basic hit 3, 4 or 5. Tap Basic after the switch to start at hit 3 in the new stance; this is not required before EX.
122100008: 本步终结技前不用普攻；落雷后想续段，可点普攻接第三段。
No Basic before the Ultimate. After the lightning strike, optionally link into Basic hit 3.
122100010: 先响应快速支援；要续普攻可在入场后直接接第三段，不必先普攻。
Respond to Quick Assist first; optionally link into Basic hit 3 on entry without an earlier Basic string.
